اعرنكسوا (form IIIq)
# اِعْرَنْكَسُوا (iʕrankasū) /iʕ.ran.ka.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# اُعْرُنْكِسُوا (uʕrunkisū) /uʕ.run.ki.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# اِعْرَنْكِسُوا (iʕrankisū) /iʕ.ran.ki.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
